title: Cross-cycle Milestone Cadence & Signal Contracts for Progressive Experiments
creator: Maya Alvarez
description:
Goal: Define a repeatable, cross-cycle cadence for progressive experiments (A/B tests, canaries, staged rollouts) and formalize 'signal contracts' — the set of metrics, thresholds, and measurement windows that must be satisfied at each milestone before traffic increases or a rollout graduates.

Scope: This ticket covers PM-owned milestone definitions, evaluation windows, metric weightings (quality vs. cost/latency), and the ops/eng responsibilities to collect, dashboard, and alert on signals. It does NOT implement dashboards or rollout automation; those are tracked as engineering sub-issues.

Acceptance criteria: 
- A milestone cadence document describing Milestone 0 (smoke), Milestone 1 (micro-canary), Milestone 2 (gradual expansion), Milestone 3 (broad release) with clear time/sample boundaries.
- Signal contract template with required primary metrics (latency p95, error rate, quality score NPS/proxy) and secondary metrics (cost per 1k tokens, model drift indicators).
- Decision rules (pass/fail/hold) with precise numeric thresholds and a rubric for manual override.
- A short playbook for failure modes and automatic rollback triggers.
- Linked artifacts: Confluence playbook, reference dashboards, and a canonical checklist for release owners.

notes: Measurement windows should be aligned with model batching behavior: long-tail sequences affect quality metrics over longer windows.
When defining quality proxies, prefer deterministic, cheap heuristics for early gates and reserve human evals for final validation.
Canary traffic should include synthetic smoke traffic to exercise edge paths (tool calling, function hooks) separate from organic traffic cohorts.
